title: Classic style, flexible checkout: Klarna and Lands' End expand partnership to Europe | Klarna International
body_markdown:
*Klarna is now live on Lands' End's sites in the UK, Germany, Austria and France, following a successful U.S. launch in May*


**New York, October 28, 2026** – Klarna, the everyday finance network, announced today the expansion of its partnership with Lands' End, the American lifestyle brand known for quality clothing built to last. Klarna is now live at checkout for customers in the UK, Germany, Austria and France.


Shoppers can choose to pay in full, in 30 days, in three interest-free installments, or through longer-term financing (availability varies by market).


The partnership is powered by Stripe and adds Lands' End to Klarna's growing network of retail partners in Europe.


"Bringing Klarna's flexible payment options to Lands' End's European sites gives shoppers more choice in how they pay for quality they can rely on, and supports a brand with a loyal following as it continues to grow," said Nicole Defren, Head of Central and Northern Europe at Klarna.


"Our customers buy Lands' End because it lasts. Giving them more flexibility at checkout, in the way they already prefer to pay, makes that easier across all our European markets," said Rob Weerts, Director eCommerce Europe at Lands' End


**About Klarna**


Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna's AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna's innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy's, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](http://klarna.com/)
